clips.title: The story
paras: Across the Barrens, Centaur Bracers are stripped from slain Kolkar warriors. Regthar Deathgate gathers them west of the Crossroads as proof that centaur raiders have been culled.

Kolkar raiders threaten the Horde’s foothold across the Barrens. Their fallen warriors leave behind leather and iron bracers, proof that a raider has been removed from the trade roads. Regthar Deathgate, an orc scout stationed on the bluffs west of the Crossroads, offers a standing bounty for these trophies to curb the tribe’s aggression.
